messages:
Mike: Hey folks, thinking about organizing a hybrid game night this Friday — small LAN at the office + Steam Remote Play for folks remote. Who's in? :joystick:
Anya: I'm down. I can bring my Switch + 3rd-party pro controllers. Will there be a dock/TV?
Sam: Count me in for LAN. I'll bring an extra ethernet switch and a couple of Cat6 cables.
Laura: Remote works better for me but I'll join via Steam Remote Play — what's the host machine specs? Any game recs? :grin:
Mike: Host PC is my rig in eng-area — 3070, 32GB. Planning to run a couple of lobbies for Rocket League, Smash (with Switch), and maybe a CS:GO retro server. If anyone wants to host a different lobby, say so.
Anya: Awesome — can we do some co-op (Overcooked or Deep Rock?) I'm bad at competitive :sweat_smile:
Sam: Overcooked yes. Also bringing an HDMI capture dongle if anyone wants to stream to the company twitch channel for fun.
Laura: Is there a plan for network isolation? I can't have personal devices on corp network.
Mike: Good call — I'll set up a guest VLAN. Quick config snippet I used before:
```
interface vlan.50
  ip address 10.55.50.1/24
  dhcp-range 10.55.50.100 10.55.50.200
  allow: remote-play
```
(not perfect, just the idea)
dev-bot: Reminder: Building access closes at 9pm on Fridays. Please badge out before then.
Mike: Noted. Anyone want to handle snacks? I'll order pizza if we get 6+ people.
Anya: I'll bring chips and a soda pack. Also have a docking kit if needed.
Sam: I'll RSVP in the poll: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-gamenight (I put times/options)
Laura: RSVP'd for remote. Thanks for organizing, Mike! :raised_hands:
Mike: Sweet — I'll post final details tomorrow (venue table, who's bringing what). If anyone's fragile to motion sickness in Rocket League, say the word :laughing:
